design: monthly not-yet-treated C&S on raw-TED-rebuilt panel (2015-2019, 25 countries, 141 cells)
finding: Paper headline (-9 to -17pp REDUCTION in single-bidding) does NOT replicate; rebuilt estimate is +4.7 to +5.4pp (no reduction / slight increase) across all specs incl paper own cohorts
caveats: pre-period starts ~2015-03 (mid-2015 schema transition); late-2015 cohorts short pre
OFFERS field has extreme values -> mean-offers unreliable, but single-bidder(==1) robust
simplified not-yet-treated estimator + country block bootstrap, not full doubly-robust C&S
implication: Central causal claim of the paper is NOT robust to rebuilding the panel from raw TED. This is an author-level decision, not an autonomous edit.
